messages.subject: saving files
parts:
I'm using r and deducer to teach grad stats. Every thing is going
smoothly but we are having trouble saving files on a Macintosh. If we
ask it to save data, we don't get a dialog box or anything. It just
sits there. Are we doing something wrong?

messages.subject: Re: saving files
parts:
open R (not JGR) and enter the following:

Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer"),,"http://rforge.net",type="source")

Re-open JGR and see if the problem persists? If it does, is there
anything printed to the console (Applications/Utilities/Console)
